description:
An ultimate internet/network control, security and statistical tool for Windows.

NetLimiter in an ultimate internet/network control, security and statistical tool for Windows.
Use it to manage bandwidth of individual applications, monitor data coming to and out of your machine in real-time, block unwanted intruders, analyze network problems and much more...
This release makes creating filters much quicker. Select multiple applications or connections in Activity (or applications in the Application List), right-click on them (opens the Context menu) and choose Create filter. The Filter editor opens with all of them already filled in.

- New Create filter command in the context menu of Activity and the Application List. Select one or more applications to create a filter for all of them (by app identity or by app path), or select connections to create a filter for their applications and remote IP addresses. The command is also available in the Info View.
- Close to Tray is now enabled by default (Tray icon options).
- New Change License link in the About window opens the license change page for your license.
- Blocker rules for loopback/localhost traffic (filters with the Is loopback traffic function) now work correctly.
- Loopback traffic is now recognized in the whole 127.0.0.0/8 range and for connections to the computer's own IP addresses.
- Starting minimized to the tray (for example at logon) is more reliable.
